tbesh_html:
1) to act as a priest, minister in a priest's office
1a) (Piel)
1a1) to minister as a priest, serve as a priest
1a2) to be or become a priest
1a3) to play the priest

strongs_1890.strongs_def: to officiate as a priest; figuratively, to put on regalia
strongs_1890.derivation: a primitive root, apparently meaning to mediate in religious services; but used only as denominative from H3548 (כֹּהֵן);
strongs_1890.kjv_def: deck, be (do the office of a, execute the, minister in the) priest('s office).
